macro_bindings.exact_original_body:
#define REQUIRE(condition)                                                                         \
    do {                                                                                           \
        if (!(condition)) {                                                                        \
            fprintf(stderr, "requirement failed at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #condition);  \
            abort();                                                                               \
        }                                                                                          \
    } while (0)
